Fix the source so that the suite passes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
- Do not add new dependencies; the standard library is all that is available.
- Keep the public API of the `solution` package unchanged: `from_roman`.
summary: I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: the 900 entry in `_VALS` was `"DCCCC"` and is now `"CM"`. That error meant `_TABLE` never contained the numeral `CM` or any numeral built from it, so `from_roman` rejected valid inputs like `CM`, `MCMXCIV`, and most of 1 to 3999. The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I did not touch anything under `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `from_roman` API.
